fullContent:
Narach Ras 
 Reference: Yoga Ratnakara Udara Chikitsa p: 597 
 Introduction 
 Narach Ras is classical preparation that keep the Vata and Pitta balanced. This Ayurvedic medicine contains heavy metal ingredients and available in tablet form. It is useful treatment for conditions like ascites and constipation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Tankana Bhasma (Borax) – 10 g 
 Maricha (Black pepper) ( Piper nigrum ) – 10 g 
 Rasa (Herbal purified Mercury) – 10 g 
 Shuddha Gandhaka (Herbal purified Sulphur) – 20 g 
 Pippali (Long pepper fruit) ( Piper longum ) – 20 g 
 Shunti (Ginger Rhizome) ( Zingiber officinalis ) – 20 g 
 Danti ( Baliospermum montanum ) – 90 g 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Store in a dry cool place. 
 Dosage 
 Consume 125 – 500 mg with water or as suggested by Ayurvedic doctor and it can be administered for a period of one month. 
 If a patient start experiencing purgation, dose is given along with curd rice and green gram gruel to stop it. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 An efficient Ayurvedic therapy for ascites. 
 Also good in treating constipation. 
 Good treatment for liver disorders. 
 Useful in Panchakarma procedure called Virechana – Purgation therapy. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 It’s Self-medication with might be unsafe as it contains heavy metal ingredient. 
 Have accurate dose of this medicine and that too for a period as suggested by doctor. 
 It’s over dose can also results in side effects. 
 Better to avoid in in pregnant and lactating women as well as in children. 
 Keep it out of the reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
